name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to the distilled 32B variant now. It’s the only model that clears the 404 block and delivers a measurable jump in raw capability without adding latency. The trade-off is accepting slightly slower inference—about 10% longer per token—but the net gain in accuracy outweighs the delay.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t latency—it’s benchmark drift. A 32B distilled model’s 0.5% gain could vanish if the benchmark suite drifts, leaving us chasing noise. Test it on a fresh 1,000-task set with human-graded gold standards; if it doesn’t hold, the trade-off fails.
